scope: Twelve core reference inputs only; this is NOT approval of any generated runtime model.
visualReview: Each generated triptych was inspected for complete front/right/back, shared regional materials and distinct progression; all family levels were compared after the set was complete.

notes.palette: Cream limestone, slate mansard, sage shutters, forest-green shopframes and dark iron remain coherent across all core families.
notes.levels: Villa/shop/hotel/tower each has one, two and three full inhabited levels; corrected villa_1 and hotel_3 ensure the attic does not substitute for a level.
notes.families: Homes have domestic openings; shops use broad glazing and awnings; hotels have independent entrance porticos and guest balconies; residences have central rounded bays and slate domes.
